items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because there were many people that he dealt with that didn’t have that monster, like Donald Byrd, Herbie Hancock.

ctx.x: Do you think he consciously used his knowledge of that?

I think so. I think that most of those record producers – Alfred [Lion] and Frank [Francis Wolff] did too, but their thing was, you got it. It’s your monster. I didn’t give it to you. I don’t even want you to use it. Because there were many people that he dealt with that didn’t have that monster, like Donald Byrd, Herbie Hancock.
